lcc_sn: 那些進去<WH0935><WTH8802>的、是凡<WAH04480><WAH03605>有血肉<WH01320>、有公<WH02145>有母<WH05347>進去<WH0935><WTH8804>的，正如<WAH09003><WAH0834>上帝<WH0430>所吩咐<WH06680><WTH8765>挪亞{<WAH0853>}的。永恆主<WH03068>就把他們關在<WH05462>船裏頭<WAH01157>。
lcc_original: 那些進去的、是凡有血肉、有公有母進去的，正如上帝所吩咐挪亞的。永恆主就把他們關在船裏頭。
notes: LCC restructures the opening clause: UNV leads with 凡<WAH04480><WAH03605>有血肉進入方舟的 (all flesh that entered the ark), while LCC opens with 那些進去的、是凡有血肉 (those who entered, being all flesh). SNs are distributed accordingly: <WH0935><WTH8802> goes on the first 進去 (那些進去的), and <WAH04480><WAH03605> goes on 凡 embedded in 是凡.

UNV's implicit {<WH0935>}{<WTH8804>} (implicit second occurrence of 'entered') is made explicit in LCC as the second 進去 (有公有母進去的). Per Rule 3, braces dropped and SN attached directly: 進去<WH0935><WTH8804>.
{<WAH0853>} (Hebrew direct object marker אֵת) kept in braces: LCC also has no explicit Chinese word for the accusative particle, so the implicit marker notation is preserved on 挪亞.
LCC uses 上帝 (vs UNV 神) for H0430, 永恆主 (vs UNV 耶和華) for H03068, and 船 (vs UNV 方舟) — SNs assigned to corresponding LCC terms without issue.
<WAH01157> (H01157 בַּעַד, 'within/behind') attaches to 裏頭 in LCC matching UNV's 裡頭<WAH01157> pattern; 船 is left unannotated as it is the LCC rendering of 方舟 which carried no SN in UNV.
